page.title: Yep Edu: watch them grow
page.description: Practice at your child's level, guided by AI. Yep Edu moves the level up when they're ready, celebrates every step, and shows you where they stand: ahead, on track, or building.

end.headline: Watch them grow.
end.body: Teachers can run a whole class on Yep Edu too, with parents deciding who joins.

layers.label: Morning practice
layers.headline: They're growing. On their own.
layers.body: Practice that meets your child exactly where they are, guided by AI, and moves up the moment they're ready.

layers.label: Their worksheet
layers.headline: Paper or screen. Always their level.
layers.body: Print a sheet with its answer key, or assign it on screen with read-aloud questions and a whiteboard for working things out.

layers.label: Growing
layers.headline: The level moves up when they're ready.
layers.body: Every question is scored on its own, so Yep Edu knows what they've mastered and moves them up only when they have. Levels are named, so a jump is a decision, not a surprise.

layers.label: A closer look
layers.headline: A tutor that asks, not tells.
layers.body: When they're stuck, the tutor answers with a question that points the way, so the “aha” is theirs.

layers.label: Step by step
layers.headline: Every step is theirs.
layers.body: Finished sheets earn stars they can spend on rewards you choose. Badges level up as they keep going, and practice games turn the hard days into a race.

layers.label: Back home
layers.headline: A clear view, from anywhere.
layers.body: See the exact questions they missed, not just a score. Friends, classes and competitions only start with your yes, and you can take it back any time.

layers.label: Their progress
layers.headline: Ahead, on track, or building. Never “behind”.
layers.body: Yep Edu compares their working level with what's usual for this time of year, and shows it as growth.
